title: Buccaneer (Drake Interplanetary, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Buccaneer is a light fighter from Drake Interplanetary in Star Citizen. The pilot sits alone, high up in the narrow body. It uses the common controls without changes.

panels.name: Buccaneer: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Buccaneer's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (five)
controls.text: The Buccaneer has five guns, a lot for its size, all fired by the pilot.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Missile racks (four missiles)
controls.text: Four missiles hang in the Buccaneer's racks. A missile flies to the locked target by itself.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.
